title: Role Forecast Shortlist and Week-Zero Handoff Playlist
content:
TL;DR: Lightweight playbook to convert a rolling shortlist into a crisp week-zero handoff. Use this when we expect an offer within 7–21 days or when hiring managers need a structured preboarding playlist. Purpose: reduce time-to-first-impact by standardizing candidate curation signals and a repeatable week-zero immersion for accepted offers.

How to use this doc (quick):
- People Ops lead curates the forecast shortlist weekly (Thu).
- Hiring manager confirms top-3 role fits and labels 'fast-track' if target start <21 days.
- Recruiter runs reference checks for top-2. If green, move to offer.
- If offer accepted, enact the Week-Zero Playlist (below) and run the handoff to eng buddy within 48h.

Section A — Role Forecast + Shortlist signals (practical, action-oriented)
1) Forecast model (qualitative):
   - Demand signal: hiring manager has >2 production bugs/quarter tied to backlog area OR product launch scoped next quarter.
   - Budget signal: budget owner confirmed 1x FTE in Q1 hiring cadence.
   - Velocity signal: recruiting has at least 5 screened candidates for the role in last 14 days.
2) Shortlist scoring (0-10, combine for top N):
   - Domain fit (0-4): direct product experience or adjacent infra/ML inference knowledge.
   - Impact trace (0-2): shipped feature or lived-oncall ownership for relevant stack.
   - Cognitive/communications (0-2): clarity on tradeoffs + asynchronous writing sample.
   - Cultural alignment (0-1): examples of cross-team collaboration at scale.
   - Logistics (0-1): visa/relocation constraints + notice period.
   - Note: fast-track label requires combined >=7 and logistics <=1.

Section B — Interview rubric highlights (for panel calibration)
- Keep each interviewer focused; 45 minutes max per loop. Use anchors: 1=Fail, 2=Below expectations, 3=Meets, 4=Above, 5=Outstanding.
- Core dimensions (short list):
  * System design/architecture (scale & tradeoffs) — expects diagrams, latency/cost reasoning (primary for infra, serving-runtime).
  * Debugging triage (oncall scenarios) — time-to-detect, mitigation steps, postmortem learnings.
  * Mini-deep-dive (day-in-role exercise) — ask the candidate to outline first 30/90 plan for the role.
  * Cross-functional communication — story about a hard stakeholder negotiation.
  * Ownership signal — shipped feature end-to-end, measured outcomes.
- Scoring matrix: capture numeric score in interview doc and one-line evidence sentence (e.g., "designed prefix cache eviction with cost estimates").

Section C — Offer / Preboarding criteria
- Must-haves before sending offer: two green references, manager sign-off on compensation band, security clearance checklist initiated if needed.
- Preboarding packet to send on acceptance (email template exists in Confluence link above): ID checklist, laptop options, first-day calendar, buddy name, 30/60/90 expectations draft.

Section D — Week-Zero Immersion Playlist (the unique part)
Goal: make the new hire feel operationally ready on Day 1 and able to contribute to a small, well-scoped task by Day 7.
Playlist items (ordered; run in parallel where possible):
  Day -7 to -1 (pre-arrival):
    - Send choice form for laptop and peripheral preferences (IT ticket auto-creates).
    - Invite to team Slack, add to repo read permissions (observer access) and to runbooks slack channel.
    - Share a 20-min "context tape" (short Loom) from hiring manager: product goals, top-3 team metrics, current priority.
    - Assign an Eng Buddy and schedule 30-min sync on Day 0. Buddy checklist: repo pointers, dev env notes, quick wins list.
  Day 0 (orientation):
    - 9:00 intro with manager (30m) — mission + expectations + quick wins list.
    - 10:00 buddy session (60m) — walkthrough of local dev env and one small ticket ready for pairing.
    - Admin & security (IT, KMS access request if private deployment work) — confirm SSO and VPN.
    - End-of-day 1: micro-retro (15m) between manager and new hire: signal if anything blocking.
  Day 1–3 (immersion):
    - Pair on small task (low-risk) with buddy (goal: merge free baseline change by Day 3).
    - Lunch intro with cross-functional PM or product owner.
    - Shadow one oncall rotation runbook and read last two postmortems.
  Day 4–7 (ramp to impact):
    - Independent ownership of a narrow ticket with buddy oversight.
    - One async write-up: 30/60/90 draft submitted to manager for feedback.
    - Checkpoint meeting on Day 7: manager + buddy + hire (30m) to review progress and blockers.

Checklist items (quick):
- [ ] Laptop delivered/accepted
- [ ] Accounts provisioned (SSO, GitHub, Jira, Slack)
- [ ] KMS/HSM access request opened (if on private deployments team)
- [ ] Eng Buddy assigned + first sync scheduled
- [ ] First pairing ticket created and triaged
- [ ] Security training module enrolled/completed (or scheduled)

Section E — Handoff script (what People Ops does vs. Hiring manager vs. Buddy)
- People Ops: finalize offer details, run background/reference checks, share preboarding packet, create IT requests.
- Hiring Manager: confirm 30/60/90 skeleton, identify first pairing ticket, introduce buddy, schedule first-week meetings.
- Eng Buddy: ensure dev env works, create onramp ticket, ready 2 small pairing sessions.
- Communication cadence: People Ops posts a 1-line onboarding status in #hiring-status when offer accepted + Day0 date.

Section F — Role-specific micro-templates (copy/paste use)
- One-line dev-ticket for Day 1 pair: "Add telemetry for model-serving inference latency for endpoint X — include CI smoke, small doc update."
- One-line PM intro template: "Quick context note: this hire will focus on latency optimization and model routing policies; first quarter goal = reduce 95th p99 by 15% on inference path."

Section G — Risk register + open questions
- Risk: candidate rescinds due to counteroffer delays. Mitigation: expedite comp approvals and provide a clear timeline in the offer.
- Risk: infra access (KMS/HSM) delays for private-deployments roles. Mitigation: prep a scoped sandbox container image for Day 0.
- Open questions: do we want to standardize a "first-output" metric (e.g., first merged PR with measurable test) for all IC hires? (PRI: medium)

Notes & reminders (informal):
- Keep the Week-Zero Playlist lean — majority of value is in pairing and the context tape.
- Managers often skip buddy scheduled time — flag in the recruiting tracker if not scheduled within 48h.
- If role is cross-functional, add an extra 1:1 with platform/product on Day 2.

Next steps / ownership:
- People Ops to pilot this playlist with Eng Platform hires in Q1 (owners: Ava + Jamal).
- Recruiter to map current pipeline to forecast model each Thu and tag fast-track candidates.
- Follow-up retro after 5 onboardings to iterate.
